The executed scholarly method was a closed-corpus synthesis: records were
captured, deduplicated and screened under the frozen inclusion frame; retained
sources were coded by admitted contribution, excluded stronger use, and
applicability warning; and the resulting limitations were propagated into the
design claims. Four procedurally separated, single-model-family roles then
reviewed the resulting report. Their \texttt{MAJOR\_REVISION} outcome and the
author's adjudication are development provenance, not evidence for a conjugacy
theorem, owner decision, or scientific result. Revision 1 changes only the
prospective contract and its stated evidence boundary.

Prospective audit coverage is separated by fixture type. A self set
\texttt{F\_self=\{(x,x)\}} targets reflexive handling; ordered reversal pairs
\texttt{(x,y)} and \texttt{(y,x)} target direction-sensitive serialization;
triples \texttt{(x,y,z)} target class-closure and transitivity consequences;
and separately sourced disagreement rows would compare canonical bytes with
an independently bound direct adjudicator. The 9,453 unordered distinct pairs
do not themselves exercise self cases, directional reversal, or three-input
closure. Without independently authored expected dispositions they are limited
to sorting, collision, binding, inverse-label, traversal-metadata, and other
byte-level bookkeeping checks. No fixture set or direct route was executed in
this study.

This is a non-executable design specification, not an implemented contract.
No schema bytes, theorem registry, frozen fixture corpus, producer, independent
verifier, or build manifest exists in the recorded project state. Accordingly,
reproducibility in this article applies only to the literature and review
artifacts listed in the materials statement; it does not apply to an owner
result, a scientific replay, or an executable certificate pipeline. Creating
those assets requires a separately authorized implementation stage.

The dominant limitation is citation resolution. The frozen workflow records
the aggregate capture, deduplication, screening, exclusion, and retention
counts, but it does not expose a complete row-level exclusion-decision ledger
or exact theorem-page and quotation locators for every transfer. All 22 prose
citation pairs therefore retain \texttt{anchor:none}, and claim-to-passage
faithfulness remains \texttt{INCONCLUSIVE}. No retrieval or source-finalization
was authorized for this revision, so the text reports the missing evidence
rather than reconstructing queries, passages, or hypotheses after the fact.

This is a target, not a proved statement. In particular, the frozen
inverse-separate owner convention still requires a theorem showing that a
hyperbolic owner cannot be conjugate to its inverse inside the exact
\texttt{Gamma\_0(11)} presentation used by P31, together with a replayable
self-reciprocity decision branch. That proof was not supplied or executed.
Until it is closed, the total disposition must return
\path{UNRESOLVED_INVERSE_SEPARATION} rather than certify two owners solely from
the convention. This fail-closed obligation does not identify an owner with
its inverse and does not alter the initial oriented-owner definition.
